scope: Independent visual inspection of the six main-figure pages only; not a new statistical audit or full-manuscript review.
method: Rendered each listed page using PyMuPDF/fitz at Matrix(2,2), 144 dpi, then individually inspected every rendered page via view_image; PDF text extraction used only to corroborate caption/panel contents.
